title: Elon Musk Settles Lawsuits Over Million-Dollar Voter Giveaway
excerpt: Elon Musk has reached a settlement regarding lawsuits filed by two Arizona residents over his 2024 daily voter giveaway lottery.
body_html:
Elon Musk has agreed to settle legal challenges concerning a 2024 initiative that promised daily payments of one million dollars to randomly chosen registered voters residing in swing states.

The campaign prompted questions regarding its legality and led to lawsuits initiated by two Arizona residents. The plaintiffs alleged that the lottery program constituted fraud. Musk has now resolved these specific legal complaints.
